nodes.title: Verifying a browser-flow fix only with devsim running
nodes.tried: bdd8446 changed the guided-start flow to wait for the browser call view. It was checked with product/web/e2e/run.sh locally, where a Python with the runtime's packages starts devsim.
nodes.broke: CI has no devsim. Without a voice runtime the test panel shows a status line instead of the call view, so CI web-e2e stayed red for one more push (bdd8446) after 54b4312.
nodes.instead: 7713d8d accepts both outcomes. A browser-flow change is now run both ways before pushing: `VP_VOICE_PYTHON=/bin/false sh product/web/e2e/run.sh` (no runtime, as in CI) and the default (devsim).
